'''Yoh''' is a Midnight Ranger NPC. She can be found in {{Location|Jinzhou}}, nearby [[Yhan]], during daytime.

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|Yoh}}

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yoh:''' The numbers don't add up... Hmm, I should count again.
----
;(After one day past in-game)
:'''Yoh:''' What an ingenious way to use this thing! Those years of service in logistics certainly taught you a few things... I'd take notes.

==Dialogue==
:'''Yoh:''' Forty-six... Forty-eight... Fifty... What's the matter? Are you looking for me?
:{{DIcon}} You look very busy.
:'''Yoh:''' Yes, the inventories won't do themselves.
:'''Yoh:''' Phew... If only I could go to the front line like the seniors of Vanguard... All I do now is count these stupid boxes every day. There's no end to this job...
:{{DIcon}} You are the buttress that supports the battles on the front line.
::'''Yoh:''' You're right, [[Qingxi]] says this to me as well. I was too being short-sighted.
::'''Yoh:''' Even the simplest logistic duties concern the safety of Jinzhou and the livelihood of the comrades on the frontline. There's no room for mistakes.
:{{DIcon}} I believe you can become the Vanguard.
::'''Yoh:''' Thank you, I will try my best. But, enough with my whining. If I can't even handle these trivial matters, I won't make it to the front line.
::'''Yoh:''' Although the Rearguard is in charge of logistics and defense on the back, I heard many of the former Rearguard members earned honors no inferior to those of the Vanguard. Perhaps my mundane task is a form of training. I can't beat myself up anymore.
{{Dialogue End}}
